name: io.github.mastercobeos/tlacuilo
title: Tlacuilo
description: 52 pay-per-call tools for AI agents over x402 (USDC): web, compliance, markets, token swaps

tools.name: catalog
tools.description: Free. Lists every tool with its price in USD, the accepted networks and how x402 payment works over MCP.

tools.name: health
tools.description: Free. Payment network, facilitator and configured data sources.

tools.name: web_read
tools.description: Read any public web page as clean, LLM-ready markdown: title, meta description, language and main content with navigation, ads and scripts removed. Follows redirects. Cheapest way to read a URL before deciding whether to pay for a full render. Price: $0.001 USDC per call (x402).

max_chars.description: Maximum characters of markdown to return, 1000-200000 (default 60000)

tools.name: x402_find
tools.description: Which x402 API should I call for this task? Searches the Coinbase Bazaar catalog and ranks candidates by evidence of real use: distinct payers, repeat calls per payer, recency of payments and price. Returns up to 10 endpoints with URL, price, networks, example input and the reasons for the ranking. Price: $0.01 USDC per call (x402).

tools.name: token_verdict
tools.description: Token verdict for a Base contract or Solana mint: DEX market data (price, liquidity, 24h volume, buys/sells, pair age), security checks (honeypot, taxes, mint/owner powers, holder concentration via GoPlus; RugCheck risks and LP lock on Solana), red and green flags, a one-word verdict and a plain-language take. Entertainment, not trading advice. Price: $0.02 USDC per call (x402).

tools.name: web_search
tools.description: Web search results as JSON: up to 30 organic results with rank, title, URL, domain and snippet, ads removed. Optional region (us-en, mx-es, de-de...) and recency filter (past day, week, month or year). No account, no key, no per-query quota to manage. Price: $0.005 USDC per call (x402).

region.description: Region-language code such as us-en, mx-es, gb-en, de-de; wt-wt for no region (default)

tools.name: web_render
tools.description: Renders a public page in a real headless Chromium with JavaScript executed, then returns the result as clean markdown, plain text or HTML: single-page apps, infinite-scroll feeds, client-side dashboards and anything the cheap fetch-based reader returns empty for. Waits for the network to go quiet, optional extra settle time, navigation, ads and trackers removed. Price: $0.02 USDC per call (x402).

wait_ms.description: Extra milliseconds to wait after the page loads, 0-8000 (default 0)

tools.name: web_screenshot
tools.description: Screenshot of a public page taken by a real headless Chromium after JavaScript runs, returned as a base64 JPEG or PNG with final URL, HTTP status and title. Viewport from 320x240 to 1920x2000, optional full-page capture and extra settle time. For visual checks, layout QA, archiving and vision-model input. Price: $0.03 USDC per call (x402).

full_page.description: true to capture the whole scrollable page (default false)

wait_ms.description: Extra milliseconds to wait after load, 0-8000 (default 500)

tools.name: msg_box
tools.description: Creates a private mailbox for agent-to-agent messaging and returns its 22-character id plus a secret read key. Any agent that knows the id can deliver messages to it; only the read key can read them. The mailbox lives 30 days; messages are kept 7 days, newest first, up to 500. Optional label for bookkeeping. Price: $0.005 USDC per call (x402).

label.description: Optional name for the mailbox, up to 80 characters

tools.name: msg_send
tools.description: Delivers a message to an agent mailbox by id: body up to 16 KB plus optional sender name and reply_to address (for example the sender's own mailbox id). Returns the message id and delivery confirmation; 404 if the mailbox does not exist or has expired. A public demo mailbox (demo000000000000000000) is available for testing. Price: $0.001 USDC per call (x402).

reply_to.description: Where replies should go, e.g. the sender's mailbox id (optional)

tools.name: msg_inbox
tools.description: Reads the newest messages of an agent mailbox; requires the mailbox id and its read key (401 otherwise). Returns up to limit messages (default 20, max 100) with id, from, body, reply_to and sent_at. Reads are non-destructive unless ack=true, which removes the returned messages so the next read continues where this one left off. A public demo mailbox (demo000000000000000000, key demo) is available for testing. Price: $0.001 USDC per call (x402).

key.description: Read key returned when the mailbox was created

ack.description: true to delete the returned messages after reading (default false)

tools.name: guard_injection
tools.description: Prompt-injection detector for text an agent is about to feed to a model: tool results, scraped pages or user input. Rules and heuristics only, no LLM, fast and deterministic. Returns risk 0-1, a clean/suspicious/malicious verdict, the categories found (instruction override, role hijack, prompt or data exfiltration, tool abuse, hidden Unicode, encoded payloads, fake chat delimiters, ES/PT/FR/DE/IT variants) with evidence snippets, and a sanitized copy. POST with JSON {text, context} also works. Price: $0.002 USDC per call (x402).

text.description: Text to inspect, up to 200 KB

context.description: Where the text comes from: tool_output, user_input (default) or web_page

tools.name: agents_readiness
tools.description: Agent-readiness audit of a website: score 0-100 and grade A-F from 18 checks fetched in parallel. Covers robots.txt rules for GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended, CCBot and Bytespider; llms.txt; sitemap.xml; openapi.json, ai-plugin.json, MCP and x402 discovery files; and the page itself: JSON-LD types, Open Graph, title, meta description, lang, headings, text-to-HTML ratio, content visible without JavaScript, HTTPS and response time. Includes concrete recommendations. Price: $0.01 USDC per call (x402).

url.description: Public http(s) URL of the site or page to audit

tools.name: dns
tools.description: Full DNS profile of a domain in one call: A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, NS, TXT, SOA and CAA records, SPF and DMARC parsed (policy, all-mechanism, reporting address), DNSSEC validation flag, and inferred providers for DNS hosting, email and web hosting. Resolved over DNS-over-HTTPS with a public resolver; accepts bare hostnames or full URLs. Price: $0.003 USDC per call (x402).

domain.description: Domain or hostname, e.g. example.com (a URL is accepted and reduced to its host)

tools.name: domain
tools.description: Domain registration record from the authoritative registry via RDAP (the successor to WHOIS): whether the domain is registered, registrar name and IANA ID, abuse contact, creation, last-change and expiration dates, days until expiry, EPP status codes, registry nameservers and DNSSEC delegation. Covers gTLDs and the ccTLDs that publish RDAP. Price: $0.005 USDC per call (x402).

tools.name: web_tables
tools.description: Every HTML table on a public web page as structured JSON: title (caption or nearest heading), headers, rows as arrays and as records keyed by header, numeric columns detected and parsed to numbers, colspan and rowspan expanded, footnote markers removed. Selecting one table by index also returns it as CSV. Row count capped by max_rows. Price: $0.003 USDC per call (x402).

url.description: Public http(s) URL of the page

index.description: Zero-based table index; when given only that table is returned, with csv

tools.name: email_validate
tools.description: Email address check without sending mail: RFC-style syntax validation, domain deliverability from MX (or A/AAAA fallback) over DNS-over-HTTPS, mail exchangers, disposable-domain and free-provider detection, role-based local parts (info, support, noreply), typo suggestion for common providers, plus-tag and canonical form (Gmail dots and tags removed), with a 0-100 score and a valid/risky/invalid verdict. Price: $0.002 USDC per call (x402).

tools.name: polymarket_markets
tools.description: Polymarket prediction markets matching a text query, or the top markets by 24-hour volume when no query is given. Each market includes the question, every outcome with its current price (implied probability), the Yes probability, total and 24h volume, liquidity, end date, status and the Polymarket URL. Source: Polymarket Gamma API. Price: $0.005 USDC per call (x402).

q.description: Words to search in market questions and event titles (optional; without it the result is the top markets by 24h volume)

active.description: true returns only open markets (default); false includes closed and resolved ones

tools.name: polymarket_market
tools.description: One Polymarket market by numeric id or slug: question, resolution description, outcomes with current prices, Yes probability, last trade, best bid and ask, 24h price change, total and 24h volume, liquidity, end date, status, parent event, tags and the Polymarket URL. Source: Polymarket Gamma API. Price: $0.003 USDC per call (x402).

id.description: Polymarket market id (e.g. 559651) or market slug

tools.name: sec_filings
tools.description: SEC EDGAR filings for a US-listed company by ticker or CIK, newest first, optionally filtered by form type (10-K, 10-Q, 8-K, 4, S-1...). Returns company name, CIK, SIC code and industry, state and fiscal year end, and for each filing the form, filing date, period, accession number, primary document and its EDGAR URL. Source: SEC submissions feed. Price: $0.005 USDC per call (x402).

ticker.description: Stock ticker, e.g. AAPL (ticker or cik is required)

cik.description: SEC Central Index Key, up to 10 digits

form.description: Form type filter, comma-separated allowed: 10-K, 10-Q, 8-K, 4, S-1, DEF 14A, 13F-HR (optional)

tools.name: sec_facts
tools.description: Reported financial values of a US-listed company from SEC XBRL company facts: the most recent annual (10-K) and quarterly (10-Q) figures for one concept such as revenue, net income, diluted EPS, total assets, cash or shares outstanding, with fiscal year, period dates, unit, form and filing date. Accepts friendly aliases or any us-gaap/dei concept name. Source: SEC EDGAR. Price: $0.005 USDC per call (x402).

ticker.description: Stock ticker, e.g. MSFT (ticker or cik is required)

cik.description: SEC Central Index Key, up to 10 digits

concept.description: Alias (revenue, net_income, eps, eps_basic, assets, liabilities, equity, cash, shares, operating_income, gross_profit, operating_cash_flow, rd, long_term_debt) or XBRL concept such as Assets or dei:EntityPublicFloat (default Revenues)

tools.name: federal_register_search
tools.description: US Federal Register documents (final rules, proposed rules, notices, presidential documents) matching a full-text query, newest first, with optional filters by agency, document type and publication date. Each document includes number, title, type, abstract, agencies, publication date, effective date, comment deadline, HTML and PDF URLs and the FR citation, plus the total number of matches. Source: Federal Register API. Price: $0.003 USDC per call (x402).

agency.description: Agency slug as used on federalregister.gov/agencies, lowercase with hyphens, e.g. environmental-protection-agency, securities-and-exchange-commission, health-and-human-services-department; comma-separated for several (optional)

type.description: RULE (final rule), PRORULE (proposed rule), NOTICE or PRESDOCU; comma-separated for several (optional)

tools.name: papers_search
tools.description: Full-text search across 250M+ scholarly works in OpenAlex: title, authors, year, venue, type, citation count, open-access status with PDF link, reconstructed abstract (up to 1500 chars) and topics. Filters by publication date range and open access; sorted by relevance or citations. Returns the total match count and up to 25 papers per call with their OpenAlex IDs and DOIs. Price: $0.005 USDC per call (x402).

q.description: Search terms (title, abstract and full text)

since.description: Earliest publication date, YYYY or YYYY-MM-DD (optional)

until.description: Latest publication date, YYYY or YYYY-MM-DD (optional)

open_access.description: true to return only open-access works, false for closed only (optional)

tools.name: papers_cite
tools.description: Formatted citation for any DOI registered with Crossref or DataCite (journal articles, books, arXiv preprints, datasets): BibTeX entry plus a formatted reference in APA, MLA, Chicago author-date, IEEE, Harvard, Nature or AMA style. Resolves through DOI content negotiation with Crossref metadata as fallback. Price: $0.002 USDC per call (x402).

doi.description: DOI, with or without the https://doi.org/ prefix

style.description: apa (default), mla, chicago, ieee, harvard, nature or ama

tools.name: clinical_trials_search
tools.description: Clinical trial search on ClinicalTrials.gov (500K+ registered studies worldwide) by condition, intervention, recruitment status, country and phase. Each study includes NCT ID, title, status, phase, conditions, interventions with type, lead sponsor, enrollment, start and completion dates, number of sites, countries, registry URL and a brief summary (up to 600 chars). Returns the total match count and up to 50 studies per call. Price: $0.005 USDC per call (x402).

condition.description: Disease or condition, e.g. type 2 diabetes

status.description: Comma-separated overall status: RECRUITING, NOT_YET_RECRUITING, ACTIVE_NOT_RECRUITING, COMPLETED, ENROLLING_BY_INVITATION, SUSPENDED, TERMINATED, WITHDRAWN, UNKNOWN (optional)

country.description: Country or city of study locations (optional)

tools.name: deps_check
tools.description: Security and freshness check for one package version across npm, PyPI, Go, Maven, Cargo and NuGet: known vulnerabilities from OSV with CVE aliases, CVSS score and level, fixed versions and advisory URL; latest version, versions behind, publish date, licenses, deprecation flag and repository links from deps.dev; and a one-word verdict (ok, outdated or vulnerable). Version defaults to the latest release. Price: $0.005 USDC per call (x402).

ecosystem.description: npm (default), pypi, go, maven, cargo or nuget

name.description: Package name, e.g. lodash, @types/node, requests, github.com/gin-gonic/gin, org.apache.logging.log4j:log4j-core

tools.name: deps_audit
tools.description: Vulnerability audit of up to 200 pinned dependencies in one call against the OSV database (npm, PyPI, Go, Maven, Cargo, NuGet). Accepts a package list or a package.json (dependencies and devDependencies, range prefixes stripped). Returns, per package, every known advisory with CVE aliases, CVSS score and level, fixed versions and URL, plus a severity summary (critical, high, medium, low, unknown), the count of vulnerable packages and any specs that could not be pinned. Price: $0.02 USDC per call (x402).

ecosystem.description: npm (default), pypi, go, maven, cargo or nuget

package_json.description: A package.json object; dependencies and devDependencies are audited (npm only)

tools.name: company_br
tools.description: Brazilian company record by CNPJ from the Receita Federal registry: legal and trade name, registration status and date, founding date, legal nature, size, share capital, main and secondary CNAE activities, full address, phone, email, Simples Nacional and MEI flags, and the partners (QSA) with roles. Check digits validated before the lookup; send the 14 digits (dots and dashes are ignored; omit the slash). Price: $0.005 USDC per call (x402).

tools.name: company_fr_search
tools.description: Searches French companies in the official INSEE-based national directory by name, SIREN or SIRET, optionally filtered by postal code and NAF activity code: SIREN, names, legal form, NAF activity, company category, headcount band, founding date, active or ceased status, number of establishments, head-office SIRET and address with coordinates, and the registered officers. Price: $0.005 USDC per call (x402).

q.description: Company name, SIREN (9 digits) or SIRET (14 digits), at least 3 characters

naf.description: NAF/APE activity code filter such as 62.01Z

tools.name: vat_eu
tools.description: Validates an EU VAT number against the European Commission's VIES system, the check required for zero-rated intra-community invoices: valid or not, and the registered name and address when the member state publishes them. All 27 member states plus Northern Ireland (XI); Greece accepted as GR or EL. Price: $0.005 USDC per call (x402).

vat.description: VAT number with 2-letter country prefix, e.g. DE811115368, FR40303265045, ESB12345678

tools.name: postal
tools.description: Postal code lookup for 60+ countries (US, CA, GB, DE, FR, ES, IT, BR, AR, IN, JP, AU and more): the places that share the code with state or region, state code and coordinates. Mexican codes have their own richer endpoint (/api/v1/cp). Price: $0.002 USDC per call (x402).

country.description: 2-letter ISO country code, e.g. us, de, br

code.description: Postal code; UK uses the outward code, e.g. SW1A

tools.name: crypto_price
tools.description: Current price of up to 25 cryptocurrencies in one call, by ticker symbol (btc, eth, sol, usdc...) or CoinGecko id, in any fiat or crypto quote currency: price, 24h change, market cap, 24h volume and last update. Covers the top coins and the Base and Solana ecosystem tokens by symbol; any other coin by its id. Price: $0.002 USDC per call (x402).

coins.description: Comma-separated symbols or CoinGecko ids, up to 25

currency.description: Quote currency code, e.g. usd, eur, mxn, btc (default usd)

tools.name: fx_latest
tools.description: Official exchange rates from the European Central Bank reference set for ~30 currencies (USD, EUR, GBP, JPY, MXN, BRL, CAD, AUD, CHF, CNY, INR...): latest rates or any business day since 1999, for any base currency and an optional amount to convert. Price: $0.001 USDC per call (x402).

tools.name: weather
tools.description: Current weather and daily forecast up to 16 days for any city name or coordinates: temperature, feels-like, humidity, precipitation, wind, day/night and a plain-language condition now, plus daily highs, lows, rain probability, wind and sunrise/sunset. Metric or imperial units; local timezone resolved automatically. Price: $0.002 USDC per call (x402).

city.description: City name, optionally with country, e.g. 'Austin, US'

tools.name: sanctions_screen
tools.description: Screens a person, company, vessel or aircraft name against the OFAC SDN list (US Treasury), the UN Security Council consolidated list and the EU consolidated financial sanctions list. Fuzzy matching tolerates transliterations, reordered names, diacritics and punctuation; every match carries a 0-1 score, the list, the sanctions programs, aliases, title, nationality and remarks. The answer states the date of the list snapshot. No key, no quota to manage. Price: $0.005 USDC per call (x402).

type.description: individual, entity, vessel or aircraft (default any)

tools.name: text_redact
tools.description: Detects and redacts personal data in text before it is logged, stored or sent to a model: emails, phones, US SSNs, payment cards (Luhn-checked), IBANs (checksum-checked), IPv4/IPv6, URLs, dates of birth, street addresses, passport or ID numbers in context, and crypto wallet addresses. Returns the redacted text plus each finding with type, value and offsets. Modes: label ([EMAIL]), mask (****1234) or remove. Up to 200,000 characters per call; nothing leaves the server. Price: $0.003 USDC per call (x402).

text.description: Text to redact, up to 200000 characters

include_findings.description: false to omit the findings array (default true)

tools.name: sec_fund_holdings
tools.description: Portfolio holdings of any US mutual fund or ETF from its latest SEC Form N-PORT filing: every position with name, CUSIP, ISIN, LEI, ticker, balance, units, value in USD, percent of net assets, asset and issuer category, country and fair-value level, plus fund totals (assets, liabilities, net assets) and the reporting period. Look up by ticker (IVV, VTI, ARKK) or SEC series id. Sort by weight, value or name; filter by asset category; up to 1,000 positions per call. Price: $0.01 USDC per call (x402).

ticker.description: Fund or ETF ticker, e.g. IVV, VTI, ARKK

series.description: SEC series id such as S000004310 (alternative to ticker)

asset_category.description: Filter by N-PORT asset category, e.g. EC (equity), DBT (debt), STIV (short-term), DE (derivative)

tools.name: solana_swap_order
tools.description: Best-price quote and ready-to-sign transaction for a token swap on Solana, routed through the Jupiter meta-aggregator (RFQ market makers plus every major DEX). Give input and output as symbols (SOL, USDC, USDT, JUP, JitoSOL, mSOL, BONK, WIF, RAY, PYTH, ETH) or mint addresses, and the amount in human units. Without taker you get the quote; with taker you also get the unsigned base64 transaction that the wallet signs itself and lands through /solana/swap/execute. Non-custodial. Price: $0.002 USDC per call (x402).

input.description: Token to sell: symbol or mint address

output.description: Token to buy: symbol or mint address

amount.description: Amount to sell in human units, e.g. 0.5 (or use amount_raw)

amount_raw.description: Amount to sell in base units (lamports, micro-USDC...)

taker.description: Wallet that signs and pays; omit for a quote only

receiver.description: Wallet that receives the output token (default taker)

slippage_bps.description: Max slippage in basis points, 0-5000 (default: Jupiter's live estimate)

tools.name: solana_swap_execute
tools.description: Lands a Solana swap built by /solana/swap/order: send the base64 transaction signed by the taker wallet plus the request_id and Jupiter broadcasts it with priority fees and confirmation handling. Returns the on-chain signature, an explorer link and the amounts actually moved, or a status of failed with the error code so the caller requests a fresh order. The wallet keeps its keys; nothing is custodied. Price: $0.002 USDC per call (x402).

signed_transaction.description: Base64 transaction from /order, signed by the taker

last_valid_block_height.description: Optional block height from /order for nonce validation

tools.name: evm_swap_order
tools.description: Best-price quote and ready-to-sign transaction for a token swap on Base (default), Ethereum, Arbitrum, Optimism, Polygon, BSC or Avalanche, routed by the KyberSwap aggregator across every major DEX. Tokens by symbol (ETH, WETH, USDC, USDT, DAI, cbBTC, AERO, DEGEN, VIRTUAL on Base) or contract address; amount in human units. With taker you get the exact transaction (to, data, value, gas) plus whether an ERC-20 approval is needed and the spender. Non-custodial. Price: $0.002 USDC per call (x402).

chain.description: base (default), ethereum, arbitrum, optimism, polygon, bsc or avalanche

input.description: Token to sell: symbol or contract address

output.description: Token to buy: symbol or contract address

amount.description: Amount to sell in human units, e.g. 0.05 (or use amount_raw)

amount_raw.description: Amount to sell in wei / base units

taker.description: Wallet that signs and pays; omit for a quote only

receiver.description: Wallet that receives the output token (default taker)

tools.name: evm_swap_execute
tools.description: Broadcasts a signed EVM transaction (a swap built by /evm/swap/order, or any other) on Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum, Optimism, Polygon, BSC or Avalanche through a public RPC and waits up to 25 seconds for the receipt. Returns the hash, an explorer link and success, failed or pending with block number and gas used. The wallet keeps its keys; nothing is custodied. Price: $0.002 USDC per call (x402).

chain.description: base (default), ethereum, arbitrum, optimism, polygon, bsc or avalanche

wait_seconds.description: Seconds to wait for the receipt, 0-25 (default 15)

tools.name: bridge_order
tools.description: Quote and ready-to-sign transaction to move value between Solana, Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum, Optimism, Polygon, BSC and Avalanche, any token to any token, through the deBridge Liquidity Network (solver-filled, typically under a minute). Tokens by symbol or address; amount in human units. Without sender you get the quote; with sender and recipient you also get the exact transaction, the ERC-20 approval it needs, an order id and the status link. Non-custodial. Price: $0.002 USDC per call (x402).

from_chain.description: Source chain: solana, base, ethereum, arbitrum, optimism, polygon, bsc or avalanche

input.description: Token to send: symbol or address on the source chain

output.description: Token to receive: symbol or address on the destination chain

amount.description: Amount to send in human units, e.g. 25 (or use amount_raw)

amount_raw.description: Amount to send in base units

sender.description: Wallet that signs and pays on the source chain; omit for a quote only

recipient.description: Wallet that receives on the destination chain (default sender when both chains share the address format)

tools.name: bridge_execute
tools.description: Broadcasts the signed transaction of a bridge order built by /bridge/order on its source chain (Solana or any of the seven EVM chains) and waits up to 25 seconds for confirmation. Returns the hash, an explorer link, success, failed or pending, and the deBridge order ids linked to the transaction with a status link to follow the delivery on the destination chain. The wallet keeps its keys; nothing is custodied. Price: $0.002 USDC per call (x402).

chain.description: Source chain of the order: solana, base, ethereum, arbitrum, optimism, polygon, bsc or avalanche

signed_transaction.description: 0x-prefixed signed raw transaction (EVM) or base64 signed transaction (Solana)

tools.name: bridge_status
tools.description: Tracks a deBridge order by its order id or by the hash of the transaction that created it: current state (created, fulfilled, unlock in transit, complete, cancelled, refunded) with a plain explanation, whether the funds have already landed on the destination chain, and a link to the order page. Price: $0.001 USDC per call (x402).

tx_hash.description: Hash or signature of the source-chain transaction, when the order id is unknown

tools.name: hyperliquid_markets
tools.description: Every perpetual market on Hyperliquid in one call: mark, mid and oracle price, hourly and annualized funding, open interest, 24 h volume and change, max leverage and lot size, sorted by volume. With coin you get that market plus the top five levels of its order book. Also reports the builder fee that orders placed through /hyperliquid/prepare carry. Price: $0.001 USDC per call (x402).

coin.description: Perp to detail, e.g. BTC, ETH, SOL, HYPE; omit for the full list

tools.name: hyperliquid_account
tools.description: State of any Hyperliquid perps account by wallet address: account value, withdrawable balance, margin in use, every open position (side, size, entry, PnL, leverage, liquidation price, funding paid) and every open order, plus whether that wallet has already approved the builder fee that orders through this API carry. Price: $0.001 USDC per call (x402).

tools.name: hyperliquid_prepare
tools.description: Builds a Hyperliquid perps action for the wallet to sign itself: market or limit order (long or short, by size or USD notional, reduce-only, post-only), cancel, leverage change, or the one-time builder-fee approval. Returns the exact action, its nonce and the EIP-712 typed data for eth_signTypedData_v4, rounded to the market's tick and lot rules, with a plain summary. When the wallet has not yet approved the builder fee, the approval comes back first. Non-custodial. Price: $0.002 USDC per call (x402).

coin.description: Perp, e.g. BTC, ETH, SOL (order, cancel, update_leverage)

size.description: Order size in coin units (order; or use usd)

usd.description: Order notional in USD, converted at mid (order)

price.description: Limit price; omit for a market order (order)

slippage_bps.description: Max slippage for market orders in basis points, 1-2000 (default 100)

reduce_only.description: true to only reduce an existing position (order)

post_only.description: true for a maker-only limit order (order)

tif.description: Gtc (default), Ioc or Alo for limit orders

cross.description: true for cross margin, false for isolated (update_leverage)

tools.name: hyperliquid_submit
tools.description: Sends a Hyperliquid action prepared by /hyperliquid/prepare and signed by the wallet (eth_signTypedData_v4) to the exchange: order, cancel, leverage change or builder-fee approval. Returns the exchange result per order (resting with its id, filled with size and average price, or the rejection reason). The signature is forwarded as-is; no key ever reaches the server. Price: $0.002 USDC per call (x402).

action.description: The action object returned by /prepare, unchanged

vault_address.description: Optional vault or sub-account address the action is for

tools.name: rfc_validar
tools.description: Validates a Mexican RFC (tax ID): structure, person type (física/moral), embedded date and SAT check digit. Offline, no SAT call. Price: $0.002 USDC per call (x402).

tools.name: curp_validar
tools.description: Validates a Mexican CURP: 18-character structure, check digit, and decodes sex, birth date and state of birth. Offline. Price: $0.002 USDC per call (x402).

tools.name: cp
tools.description: Mexican postal code lookup from the national catalog of Correos de México: state, municipality, city and every neighborhood (colonia) with its settlement type. Price: $0.003 USDC per call (x402).

tools.name: dias_habiles
tools.description: Mexican banking business days per the CNBV calendar: whether a date is a business day, the next and previous business day, and a date plus N business days. Price: $0.002 USDC per call (x402).

dias.description: Business days to add, may be negative (default 0)

tools.name: uma
tools.description: Current and historical UMA (Unidad de Medida y Actualización) values published by INEGI: daily, monthly and annual amounts with their effective dates. Price: $0.001 USDC per call (x402).

tools.name: salario_minimo
tools.description: Mexican minimum wage set by CONASAMI: general daily rate and the Northern Border Free Zone rate for a given year, with monthly equivalents. Price: $0.001 USDC per call (x402).

tools.name: iva
tools.description: Mexican VAT (IVA) and retention rates: general 16%, northern/southern border 8%, 0% and exempt categories, plus ISR and IVA retention rates for professional services and leases. Price: $0.001 USDC per call (x402).

tools.name: banxico
tools.description: Latest value of an official Banco de México series: fix (USD/MXN FIX rate), udis, tiie28, tasa-objetivo, or any raw SIE series ID. Returns the date and value as published. Price: $0.003 USDC per call (x402).

serie.description: fix | udis | tiie28 | tasa-objetivo | SIE series id

tools.name: sat_69b
tools.description: Checks an RFC against the SAT 69-B list of taxpayers with presumed non-existent operations (EFOS). Returns status (presunto, desvirtuado, definitivo, sentencia favorable), notice numbers and publication dates. Price: $0.02 USDC per call (x402).

tools.name: sat_cfdi_verificar
tools.description: Verifies a CFDI 3.3/4.0 invoice against the SAT web service: whether it exists, is vigente or cancelado, its cancellation status and EFOS flag. Needs UUID, issuer RFC, receiver RFC, total and the last 8 characters of the seal. Price: $0.03 USDC per call (x402).

tt.description: Total amount as in the XML

tools.name: empresas_buscar
tools.description: Searches Mexican businesses in INEGI's DENUE directory (5M+ establishments) by name or keyword, optionally filtered by state. Returns name, legal name, activity, address, postal code, phone, email, website, size and coordinates. Price: $0.05 USDC per call (x402).

tools.name: empresas_cerca
tools.description: Finds Mexican businesses near a coordinate using INEGI's DENUE: keyword plus latitude, longitude and radius up to 5,000 m. Same fields as the name search. Price: $0.05 USDC per call (x402).

tools.name: empresas
tools.description: Full record of one Mexican business from INEGI's DENUE by establishment ID: identification, activity, address, contact, size, type and coordinates. Price: $0.02 USDC per call (x402).
